notes: Chinese peer-published radiocarbon study of Pit 4. Cited by Li et al. 2022 Antiquity for six dates giving 1260–924 cal BC. Chinese text (PDF accessed 2026-10-11 via Sichuan Cultural Relics institute mirror): Bayesian R_Combine on six AMS samples; 95.4% range 3148–2966 cal BP; 68.3% 3072–3003 cal BP. Pit 4 described as roughly square ~2.9 m side, deepest ~1.6 m. Use calibrated ranges as author-stated research results — chronology of other pits still debated.
